    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    objects = image_patch.find("it")
    if not objects: return image_patch
    
    # Sort objects by area to determine which half is larger
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: (obj.upper - obj.lower) * (obj.right - obj.left), reverse=True)
    
    # Get the largest object
    largest_object = objects[0]
    
    # Calculate the center of the largest object
    center_x = (largest_object.left + largest_object.right) / 2
    center_y = (largest_object.lower + largest_object.upper) / 2
    
    # Split the objects into two halves based on their centers
    left_half = [obj for obj in objects if obj.horizontal_center < center_x]
    right_half = [obj for obj in objects if obj.horizontal_center >= center_x]
    
    # Determine which half is larger
    if len(left_half) > len(right_half):
        return depth_order(left_half)[0]
    else:
        return depth_order(right_half)[0]

    bacon_patches = image_patch.find("bacon")
    if not bacon_patches: return image_patch
    bacon_depths = [b.compute_depth() for b in bacon_patches]
    closest_bacon_index = bacon_depths.index(min(bacon_depths))
    closest_bacon = bacon_patches[closest_bacon_index]
    
    egg_patches = image_patch.find("egg")
    if not egg_patches: return closest_bacon

    closest_egg_index = egg_depths.index(min(egg_depths))
    closest_egg = egg_patches[closest_egg_index]
    
    return closest_bacon if closest_bacon.compute_depth() < closest_egg.compute_depth() else closest_egg
